metadata.Name: Russian Financial Statements Database
metadata.Description: A comprehensive dataset of Russian financial statements from 2011 to 2023.
Provider: The Institute for the Rule of Law
Derived From: Uniform State Register of Legal Entities (EGRUL)
Federal State Statistics Service of Russia (Rosstat)
metadata.Paper Title: Russian Financial Statements Database: A firm-level collection of the universe of financial statements
Affiliations: European University at Saint Petersburg, The Institute for the Rule of Law
metadata.Abstract: The Russian Financial Statements Database (RFSD) is an open, harmonized collection of annual unconsolidated financial statements of the universe of Russian firms in 2011--2023. It is the first open data set with information on every active firm in the country, including non-filing firms. With 56.6 million geolocated firm-year observations gathered from two official sources, the RFSD features multiple end-user quality-of-life improvements such as data imputation, statement articulation, harmonization across data providers and formats, and data enrichment.
